title: Midcentury Gem- 5 minutes to the Opry!
description: Spacious midcentury ranch style home w/ original 1960 details nestled in beautiful, quiet, accessible Donelson neighborhood. 3 bedrooms, sleeps 6, patio with fire pit, gas grill, covered parking. 15 min drive to Downtown Nashville, 10 min to airport, 5 min to Grand Ole Opry. Grocery, convenience, and popular restaurants (Tennfold, Urban Nectar) less than a mile away. Short walk to Two Rivers Park and golf course, and greenway access taking you to East Nashville and downtown.
